title: Airport at 5 a.m.
synopsis: Your flight is in ninety minutes. The taxi smells like coffee and bad news.

nodes.text: Driver: chatty. Radio: jazz. Traffic: ominous.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Friend.
There is no taking “Pretend to nap” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: He knows a shortcut through old downtown.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Smart.

nodes.text: A crane blocks the shortcut. He sighs theatrically.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Civil—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.

nodes.text: Forty minutes to gate. The TSA line wraps the building.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Charm the gate agent” back. Spirit shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Final boarding. You and your laptop bag, panting.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Apologize to the row.” The story records the instinct as “Civil” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Sit and immediately read.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Sun comes up over the wing. The bag's safe. Nobody died.

choices.consequence: “Order coffee” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Joy.
There is no taking “Sleep” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You and the driver text occasionally. He's a writer in his free time. His pieces are, against all odds, good.
You land. You forget the cab in three days. You remember the jazz for years.
